namespaceOwnership.requirement: An authenticated owner must create the npm organization with MFA plus a second owner and record ownership evidence before any release step. A registry 404 does not prove ownership.

authentication.bootstrapException: npm cannot configure a trusted publisher before a package exists, so the first 0.1.0 publish runs from the sdk-publish GitHub Actions workflow with a short-lived granular token stored only as a repository secret; the token is revoked and the secret deleted immediately after, and the trusted publisher is configured before any subsequent release.

releaseGates.detail: npm pack --dry-run must reproduce exactly the reviewed api/package-files.json file set and sizes.
The committed compatibility matrix must be regenerated by a passing run against the target chain version.
Recorded npm organization ownership with MFA and a second owner; recheck identifier availability immediately before publication.
Actual public publishing requires explicit approval; no automation may publish.

rollback.method: npm deprecate the affected version with a reason and publish a fixed successor

steps: Deprecate every affected version immediately with a warning message.
Rotate or revoke the trusted-publishing configuration before any further release.
Publish a private security advisory via the repository advisory form and coordinate disclosure.
Publish a patched release from a clean, re-reviewed checkout with fresh provenance.
Record the incident and response in docs/changes/.
